kpis.signal: Barclays already exceeds its 2026 target (>12%) with a clear trajectory toward >14% in 2028
Solid ratio above the 13-14% target range, showing strong capital position
Robust NII growth supported by the rate environment and structural hedge strength
Continued operating efficiency improvement, in line with the 'low 50s' target
Loan loss rate under control, within the long-term 50-60 bps target range.
Strong commitment to capital return, with over GBP 15 Bn planned between 2026 and 2028
